eta.note: ETA divides remaining DCS-attested verb roots by the mean roots promoted per active day (from store provenance timestamps of already-promoted roots) — rate unit is roots/day, matching the remaining-roots numerator; still an estimate.

nominal.note: Nominal burn-down: remaining runnable candidates divided by the mean keys promoted per active day (store provenance timestamps of already-promoted keys).
